verdicts.title: Tutte Polynomials of Symmetric Hyperplane Arrangements
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Originally in 1954 the Tutte polynomial was a bivariate polynomial associated to a graph in order to enumerate the colorings of this graph and of its dual graph at the same time. verdicts.title: Morse theory, Milnor fibers and minimality of hyperplane arrangements
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Through the study of Morse theory on the associated Milnor fiber, we show that complex hyperplane arrangement complements are minimal. That is, the complement of a complex hyperplane arrangement has the homotopy type of a CW complex in which the number of p-cells equals the p-th betti number.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the homotopy type of complex hyperplane arrangement complements (minimal CW structure with p-cells matching Betti numbers), which does not address Zaslavsky chamber counts on the Boolean cube or AC⁰ circuit size lower bounds for PARITY.
